recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to language extension applicability should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than in the core FHIR checkout; no FHIR-22692 follow-up is needed.
issue_request: FHIR-22692 was a Published/Persuasive MnM change request raised against STU3 and applied for R5. It requested broader applicability for http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/language, with the final resolution to allow the extension on the string and markdown datatypes.
initial_application: Core commit ec83d5b5057f1402bdeb77453f5d214806de6b8c applied the issue as part of MnM R5 non-substantive changes by changing the language extension row in source/profiles/general-extensions-spreadsheet.xml from HumanName;Address;Annotation to HumanName;Address;Annotation;string;markdown.
additional_context: Core extension definitions were later split out of the FHIR core source. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed the language extension row from the core general-extensions spreadsheet, and the FHIR Extension Pack imported and still maintains input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-language.xml with contexts for HumanName, Address, Annotation, string, and markdown. Current core source links to the extension through [%extensions-location%]StructureDefinition-language.html and does not contain an active language extension definition in source/fhir.ini profiles.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current maintained extension definition already satisfies the Jira resolution, and restoring or duplicating the definition in core would be contrary to the current build ownership split.
